srs: The sports registration system records Athlete, Registration, TournamentService, and Event; each has an id attribute. Each Athlete can have zero or more Registration records, and each Registration belongs to exactly one Athlete. Each Registration uses exactly one TournamentService, and each TournamentService serves zero or more Registration records. Each TournamentService manages one or more Event records by composition, and each Event belongs to exactly one TournamentService. Each Athlete can reference zero or more Event records, and each Event can be referenced by zero or more Athlete records.
